dek: CosyVoice Studio bundles Alibaba's Qwen-Audio speech family, including the Artificial Analysis top-ranked Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime, into one platform with three product modules. Alibaba is positioning speech as the next agent entry point, alongside text and vision.
